==English== {{wp}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|gīd}}, {{IPA|en|/ɡaɪd/}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-guide.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ɡɛɪd/|a=Northumbria}} * {{rhymes|en|aɪd|s=1}} ===Etymology 1=== {{etymon|en|id=noun|:inh|enm:guide>>>>>>>|tree=1}} c. 1325–75. From {{inh|en|enm|guide}}, from the {{der|en|fro|guide}}, from {{der|en|pro|guida}}, from {{m|pro|guidar}}, from {{der|en|frk|*wītan|t=to show the way, lead}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*wītaną|t=to see, know; go, depart}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*weyd-|t=to see, know}}. Cognate with {{cog|ang|wītan|t=to see, take heed to, watch after, guard, keep}}. Related also to {{cog|en|wit}}. ====Noun==== {{en-noun}} # Someone who [[#Verb|guides]], especially someone hired to show people around a [[place]] or an [[institution]] and offer [[information]] and [[explanation]], or to lead them through dangerous [[terrain]]. #: {{synonyms|en|guider|xenagogue}} #: {{ux|en|The '''guide''' led us around the museum and explained the exhibits.}} #* {{RQ:KJV|Psalms|xlviii|14|text=He will be our '''guide''', even unto death.}} # {{senseid|en|guidebook}} A [[document]] or [[book]] that offers information or [[instruction]]; [[guidebook]]. # {{senseid|en|sign}} A [[sign]] that guides people; [[guidepost]]. # Any marking or object that catches the eye to provide quick [[reference]]. # {{synonym of|en|legend}}, a [[key]] to [[symbol]]s, [[abbreviation]]s, and [[term]]s on a [[map]], [[chart]], [[etc.]] # A [[device]] that guides part of a [[machine]], or guides [[motion]] or [[action]]. ## A blade or channel for directing the flow of water to the buckets in a [[water wheel]]. ## A [[grooved]] [[director]] for a [[probe]] or [[knife]] in [[surgery]]. ## {{lb|en|printing|dated}} A strip or device to direct the [[compositor]]'s eye to the line of copy being set. # {{lb|en|occult}} A [[spirit]] believed to speak through a [[medium]]. # {{lb|en|military}} A member of a group [[march]]ing in [[formation]] who sets the [[pattern]] of [[movement]] or [[alignment]] for the rest. =====Synonyms===== * {{sense|person who leads and explains}} {{l|en|interpreter}} {{q|uncommon}} =====Derived terms===== {{col|en|ABC guide |Adirondack
